Home_DidYouKnow1: You can open any existing addon and it will load all properties such as heels or hats.
Home_DidYouKnow2: You can export an existing project when you are not finished and later import it to continue working on it.
Home_DidYouKnow3: There is switch to enable dark theme in the settings.
Home_DidYouKnow4: There is 'live texture' feature in 3d preview? It allows you to see how your texture looks on the model in real time, even after changes.
Home_DidYouKnow5: You can click SHIFT + DEL to instantly delete a selected drawable, without popup.
Home_DidYouKnow6: You can click CTRL + DEL to instantly replace a selected drawable with reserved drawable.
Home_DidYouKnow7: You can reserve your drawables and later change it to real model.
Home_DidYouKnow8: Supporting me with monthly patreon will speed up the development of the tool!
Home_DidYouKnow9: You can hover over warning icon to see what is wrong with your drawable or texture.
